depicts: Two strokes splitting away from each other, like something being divided in two.
An unborn baby curled up inside a womb that wraps around it like a bundle.
The green calyx of a flower: a small cup of pointed sepals on a stem that once held a bloom.
A cart seen from above: two big wheels, an axle, a shaft, and the box of the cart between them.
A cloth sack bulging in the middle, both ends tied shut with cord.
A small toddler: a big round head with a soft spot on top and little legs below.
Two boat hulls lashed side by side into a raft, their bows tied together.
A bird in flight, wings spread wide and tail feathers streaming behind it.
A forked pole weapon: a long shaft splitting into two prongs at the top.
A tall watchtower: a roofed building with a doorway, raised on a high platform.
An ancient carpenter's square: a thick I-shaped measuring tool with notched ends.
A round fruit hanging at the very top of a tree, trunk and branches below it.
A whirlpool: two concentric squared spirals turning around a centre.
A central flame tongue rising up with two smaller flames flickering out at its sides.
A tall gatehouse on a high mound: a roofed building raised on an earthen platform.
A bent arm: upper arm and forearm folded at the elbow, reaching out.
An open mouth: one simple rounded square outline, nothing more.
A stalk of wheat: a vertical stem with grains and long awns (bristles) at its head.
A horse in profile facing left: crested mane, one visible eye, four legs and a long flowing tail.
A tuft of hair: fine strands bending over together from a root.
A double-leaf gate: two door panels hanging in a frame.
Loose grains of rice as small dots clustered around a central husk on a stem.
A human face drawn full-on: an outline of a face with one eye in the middle.
A bull's head seen from the front: two curved horns, ears at the sides, and a muzzle below.
A woman kneeling in profile with her arms folded in front of her body.
Three long wavy horizontal bands stacked one above another, like layers of drifting cloud or steam.
A person in profile: a bent back, one arm hanging down, and legs mid-stride.
A ring for the sun: a circle with a short mark in its centre.
A cut of meat: a chunk with the grain of flesh and fat drawn as lines inside it.
Three mountain peaks rising from one ground line, the middle peak the tallest.
A person in profile with a big swollen belly: a pregnant body.
A young shoot with two new leaves pushing up out of a line of soil.
An open hand with fingers spread, palm facing the viewer.
A main stream flowing down the middle with smaller streams splashing off to both sides.
A fishing net hung open: a straight top edge with a mesh of crossed lines below.
A standing person seen from the front with decorative tattoo lines drawn across the chest.
A bird settled in its nest at sunset: a round nest with a bird resting inside it.
Three tiny grains of sand lying side by side.
A kneeling person drawn with a greatly oversized head — the head is the whole point of the picture.
A robe with wide sleeves: a collar crossing at the neck, sleeves hanging at both sides, and a skirt below.
A line of sky at the top, a band of cloud under it, and four raindrops falling through the air.
A slim crescent moon with its horns pointing up and a short stroke inside the crescent.
A baby with a big head and waving arms, its lower body wrapped in swaddling clothes.
A waist belt with a sash hanging down the front and small objects dangling from its loops.
A length of thread with a knot tied at both ends, hanging down.
A beard: strands of hair hanging down from a chin.
A house built under a cliff: a wide sloping roof over an open front.
A length of cord bent into a squared-off coil, partly unwound.
A person standing with legs crossed at the ankles and arms folded across the chest.
An axe seen from the side: a broad curved blade mounted on a handle.
An ancient plough: a long curved handle coming down to a forked share that bites into the soil.
An eye drawn on its side: an outline with the pupil as a mark in the middle.
A perched bird in profile: crested head with beak and eye, folded wing, tail feathers and clawed feet.
A log split lengthwise: one half of a trunk with its flat split face forward.
A sacrificial stand seen from the front: a flat top carried on legs, like a small altar table.
A sacrificial altar: a table-like stand with offerings hanging from its top board.
A snake with its head raised: a small head and a very long body curving down into a drooping tail.
A scorpion: a round body with claws at the front, jointed legs at the sides and a curved sting tail.
A heart organ: a rounded sac with the great vessels curving out of its top.
A crossroads seen from above: one road crossing another at right angles.
A person standing with both hands planted on their waist, elbows out.
A right hand seen from the side, its fingers curled as if gripping.
A fish in profile: triangular head with mouth and eye, a scaled body, fins, and a forked tail.
A cloud curling over on itself: a straight stroke on top with a spiral swirl hanging below.
An old man with very long hair streaming behind him, leaning on a walking staff.
An oil lamp on a stand: a stem rising to a shallow dish with a single flame burning on top.
A nose seen from the front: the bridge, the two nostrils and the wings of the nose.
A steep cliff face: one long slope dropping away from a top edge.
A person seen from the front, standing tall with arms stretched wide and legs apart.
A curved single-edged knife blade with a short handle.
Three young grass shoots sprouting in a row from a single ground stem.
A person standing squarely on a ground line, seen from the front.
A dragon rearing up: a horned head with open jaws at the top of a long serpentine body ending in a tail.
A tree: a straight trunk, branches spreading up and out, and roots spreading down into the ground.
Three heads of grain standing in a row, all grown to exactly the same height.
A measuring dipper: a deep cup with a long flat handle sticking out to one side.
A rounded boulder lying at the foot of a cliff overhang.
A head with a full mass of hair on top, hair strokes rising above the face.
A mound of earth heaped up on a flat ground line, like a small altar of soil.
An elephant in profile: a huge ear, a long trunk curling down, tusks, a massive body and four column legs.
A sheep's head seen from the front: two curling horns, ears, and a pointed face below.
An arrow flying downward and striking a horizontal ground line point-first.
A whole leg: a circle for the kneecap at the top, the shin below, and a foot at the bottom.
A big thick snake coiled up, its head raised at one end of the coil.
A cowrie shell: an oval shell with a serrated slit running down its middle.
A snake rearing up: a triangular head with an eye on a thick body curving down into a tail.
A stemmed serving bowl: a wide dish on a tall flared foot, with a raised rim.
An ear seen from the side: an outer rim, inner folds, and the ear opening.
A round melon hanging from a curling vine with leaves.
One single leaf of a door — half of a double gate — with its pivot post.
A small low table with short legs, drawn from the side.
An animal horn: thick and curved with ringed ridges along it, tapering to a point.
A rectangular cloth hanging down from a horizontal strap, its lower edge loose.
Water gushing out of a round spring mouth in rock and streaming away below it.
An open umbrella from the side: a curved canopy with ribs and a straight handle below.
A bolt of lightning zigzagging down from the sky.
Upper and lower molar teeth meshing together, their cusped crowns interlocked.
The ground plan of a building drawn from above: a square outline with a cross-shaped inner plan.
Three flat jade tablets strung together on one vertical cord.
A clan banner: a tall pole planted in a base, with long streamers flying from its top.
Writing slips bound into a book: vertical bamboo strips tied together by two horizontal cords.
A broad shield with one eye peeking over its top edge.
A flayed animal hide stretched out flat: the head at the top and legs splayed at the corners.
A tiger rearing in profile: a big head with open jaws, a striped body, powerful legs and a long tail.
A spear: a leaf-shaped spearhead mounted on a long straight shaft.
A person with mouth wide open, yawning, breath rising from the mouth.
A rat in profile: pointed snout with whiskers and teeth, round ears, a plump body, little feet and a long thin tail.
A rabbit crouching in profile: long ears laid back, a round body, a short tail and folded legs.
A stomach: a curved sac filled with grain, sitting above a strip of flesh.
A crescent moon only half risen: the lower half of a crescent showing at dusk.
A sharp tattooing knife standing upright on its point.
A seedling bending sideways as it forces its way out of the soil in spring.
Two long feathers side by side, each with a central quill and fine barbs along both sides.
Two bamboo stalks side by side, each with pointed leaves drooping from its upper joints.
A round pot with a domed lid and a small knob on top, its belly swelling out.
The square wooden frame of a well seen from above: crossed timbers forming a grid over the opening.
A shallow rectangular tray with bent-up sides — a frame used for raising silkworms.
A ladle: a small round cup with a long handle curving out of it.
A tongue lolling out of an open mouth, its tip flicking upward.
A rectangular field divided by crossing paths into four plots, like a paddy seen from above.
A crow in profile like a bird drawing — head, beak, wing, tail and feet — but with no eye dot, because the crow is too black for its eye to show.
A shallow sacrificial dish with a single drop of blood in the middle of it.
A weaving shuttle: a pointed peg with thread being pushed across the warp threads.
One eye drawn upright and vertical — the eye of a head bowed low in submission.
Three long parallel streams of water flowing downward side by side.
A bronze tripod cauldron: a round belly, two handles on the rim, and three sturdy legs.
A strung bow: a deeply curved bow with its string drawn straight down one side.
A standing grain plant: a stalk with leaves and a heavy drooping ear of grain at the top.
A deer in profile: a head crowned with big branching antlers, a slim body and four thin legs.
An eyebrow arching over an eye: a curved brow with hair strokes, the eye below it.
A dog standing in profile: pointed ears, a long snout, a curled tail, and a spot marking its side.
An arrow: a pointed metal head, a straight shaft, and feather fletching at the tail.
A cave dwelling: an arched mound of earth with a dark entrance opening under its roof.
A boat from the side: a narrow hull with raised bow and stern and a line for its deck.
A clawed foot pressing down: sharp talons curving out of a pad.
